The Senior Refuel Floor Specialist (Project Manager) will provide direct management and supervision of Boiling Water Reactor (BWR) Refuel Floor maintenance activities, including Reactor Disassembly, Reassembly, and In Vessel Maintenance. This individual will support the safe execution of complex projects and activities involving BWR 2-6 Refuel Floor outages. The Project Manager will be responsible for all aspects of the project from ITO through OTR and serve as the primary GVH representative for Refuel Floor scope delivery.

Roles and Responsibilities

Serve as the single point of contact and maintain ownership of all Refuel Floor related tasks for GVH owned outage scope.
Manage all aspects of the Refuel Floor project from ITO through OTR, including technical communications, risk assessment, financial monitoring and forecasting.
Provide project delivery planning leadership and rigor. Transition planning, risk identification, risk mitigation, and contingency planning.
Responsible for leading and coaching multi-disciplined and multi-cultural teams composed of GVH and contingent worker personnel, including craft labor.
Provide direct supervision of union and non-union personnel performing activities related to BWR Refuel Floor outage maintenance work.
Support the development of commercial proposals by providing technical input on labor quantity, labor hours, tooling, and logistics.
Establish trusting relationships and interact effectively with senior level customer and supplier management on commercial, execution, technical, and compliance issues.
Support Product Line activities including proposal development, product development, growth initiatives, and training development & delivery as business needs dictate.

Exemplify our GE Beliefs and demonstrate integrity, nuclear safety, and quality culture.
Provide leadership to ensure high quality deliverables are produced in accordance with customer requirements, business procedures, and regulatory guidelines
Drive standard GVH processes across projects and ensure procedural compliance.
Perform other assignments as business needs dictate.
Support multiple Refueling Outages per year at various customer owned plants both domestically and internationally.
Exemplify our GE Beliefs and demonstrate integrity, nuclear safety, and quality culture.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager
| Launch & Scale Operations
Skye Health | Full-Time, W-2 | Remote
Position Overview

● Skye Health is seeking a hands-on Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of its telehealth business. This role spans multiple interconnected workstreams across operations, clinical support, technology, Customer Service, hiring, vendors, and implementation.
● The Project Manager will work closely with Skye’s Head of Operations to create structure, clarify priorities and ownership, and keep important initiatives moving to completion. The role is best suited for someone who can quickly understand a fast-moving environment, identify where coordination or follow-through is breaking down, and create practical systems without adding unnecessary process.
Employment & Working Model
• This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working closely with Skye’s Head of Operations and cross-functional teams. The Project Manager will gain broad exposure to key workstreams, take ownership of follow-through, and help create the structure and operating systems needed as Skye launches and scales.
• Compensation: $80,000 annual salary, plus benefits.
Key Responsibilities

Launch & Cross-Functional Project Management
• Maintain a clear view of active launch and scale workstreams, including priorities, owners, timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and next steps.
• Coordinate across teams and partners to keep work moving, clarify ownership, and ensure important actions and follow-up are completed.
• Identify blockers, gaps, competing priorities, or issues requiring leadership attention and surface them at the right time.
Operational Partnership & Leadership Support
• Work closely with leadership to understand how work moves, where time is being consumed, and where additional structure or follow-through is needed.
• Organize information and coordination across meetings, messages, workstreams, and stakeholders so ownership and next steps remain clear.
• Help protect leadership bandwidth by routing work appropriately, reducing unnecessary one-off interruptions, and coordinating internal and external resources.
Implementation & Transition Management
• Support major implementations and transitions by keeping milestones, dependencies, testing, handoffs, ownership, and open items visible and moving through completion.
• Coordinate across internal teams, external partners, and new resources to surface risks, resolve gaps, and ensure key workflows and implementation issues are addressed before they become recurring operational problems.
Systems, AI & Automation
• Identify recurring manual work, repeated questions, and process friction that can be standardized, automated, or supported with better tools.
• Use AI, automation, templates, and workflow improvements to increase internal efficiency and translate recurring operational needs into clear requirements for technical teams.
• Partner with the appropriate clinical, operational, and technical owners to ensure AI-supported workflows reflect approved content, business rules, and escalation boundaries.
Hiring, Onboarding & Team Coordination
• Support hiring and onboarding logistics as needed, including candidate coordination, follow-up, and onboarding plans.
• Help new team members, contractors, and other resources integrate smoothly with clear responsibilities, priorities, documentation, dependencies, and handoffs.
Metrics & Continuous Improvement
• Identify recurring operational issues and opportunities to improve how work moves across teams.
• Help establish practical operating metrics and dashboards that give leadership visibility into launch, scale, workload, and execution.
• Clarify where key data lives, who owns it, and which measures are useful enough to drive action rather than create reporting for reporting’s sake.
Role Boundaries
• Coordinate and operationalize cross-functional work without replacing the clinical, legal, compliance, technical, or other subject-matter owners responsible for substantive decisions.
• The role will evolve as Skye Health launches and scales, with priorities reviewed regularly with leadership.
Qualifications

Required
• Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects or operations in a fast-moving organization.
• Experience working in a startup, high-growth, or similarly dynamic environment where priorities and processes are still evolving.
• Strong ability to create structure, clarify ownership, and move work forward with limited direction.
• Excellent organization, follow-through, judgment, and attention to detail.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize input from multiple stakeholders and work independently with senior leaders.
Preferred
• Digital health, telehealth, healthcare operations, or other regulated-industry experience.
• Experience coordinating technology implementations, cross-functional operational work, or vendor transitions.
• Experience building workflows, SOPs, automations, internal systems, or operational dashboards and metrics.
• Experience using AI and automation to improve operational efficiency.
Success in This Role
• Success means Skye Health has a clear operating rhythm as it launches and scales: priorities and ownership are visible, cross-functional work stays on track, and leadership has better visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.
• Over time, the role should reduce the amount of day-to-day coordination leadership has to personally manage while helping the organization operate with greater clarity, consistency, and follow-through.

Michael Baker International’s Broadband Practice provides broadband and telecommunications consulting and engineering services to state broadband offices, public agencies, municipalities, and other government entities nationwide. This is a dynamic consulting role that combines project leadership, financial management, and client-facing responsibilities with a strong understanding of broadband funding programs, technologies, and infrastructure. The Broadband Project Manager (Consulting)

Experience monitoring project financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, invoicing, and change control.

Organized, process-driven approach with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize competing demands, adapt to changing requirements, and work effectively with limited supervision.

Experience with broadband planning, feasibility studies, data analysis and mapping, technical reviews, grant administration, or program implementation.

The Global Circularity & Resilience Program Manager is responsible for leading GE Vernova's enterprise-wide circularity strategy and 4R Circularity Program (Rethink, Reduce, Reuse, Recycle). This role will drive development, deployment, governance, and continuous improvement of circular economy initiatives across GE Vernova's businesses, functions, and global operations. The Global Circularity & Resilience Program Manager will serve as the company's subject matter expert for circular economy, critical materials, material resilience, and resource stewardship. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Services, Supply Chain, Sustainability, and Business leadership teams to embed circularity and resilience principles into products, services, operations, and value chains.

This position will report into the Environmental Sustainability Operations Leader on the Corporate Sustainability team and support both corporate and segment sustainability priorities. The role will help accelerate circular innovation, sustainable materials adoption, product life extension strategies, critical materials recovery, supply chain resilience, and resource efficiency while creating measurable environmental and business value.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

Lead the enterprise 4R Circularity Program and maintain a multi-year roadmap aligned with GE Vernova sustainability priorities and goals.
Define circularity standards, methodologies, governance processes, and guidance for use across businesses.
Partner with R&D, Engineering, Technology, Product Management, and Services teams to integrate circularity into New Products and Technology Introductions, product stewardship, and lifecycle management processes.
Advance Design for Circularity priorities including durability, repairability, refurbishment, remanufacturing, reuse, recycling, and material recovery.
Lead circular materials strategies with Sourcing and Supplier teams to accelerate recycled, renewable, and low-carbon materials adoption, material recovery, and reduced reliance on virgin materials.
Lead resource resilience strategies to identify and mitigate risks related to critical materials, resource scarcity, supply disruptions, and geopolitical dependencies.
Support enterprise strategies to improve long-term material availability, resource security, supply chain resilience, and critical materials recovery through circular economy approaches.
Develop enterprise circularity KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track progress, support leadership reviews and MORs, and drive continuous improvement through Kaizen events.
Support sustainability disclosures, customer requests, and regulatory requirements related to circular economy, resource use, products, and materials.
Work closely with Digital Technology and data teams to improve circularity data quality, automation, and reporting capability.
Facilitate communities of practice and support segment teams in identifying circularity opportunities, barriers, corrective actions, and priorities.
Monitor circular economy regulations, customer expectations, industry trends, and external best practices.
Represent GE Vernova in industry associations, partnerships, customer engagements, and forums.
Identify business value opportunities through circular business models, lifecycle services, resource efficiency, and sustainable materials innovation.

Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive change in a global matrix organization.
Experience managing program governance, metrics, reporting, and updates.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Are you ready to join an innovative company with over 100 years of excellence and a steadfast commitment to ethical business practices? Amentum is hiring a Microelectronics Program Manager to support our U.S. government customers.

This role offers a unique opportunity to leverage your expertise in the microelectronics and semiconductor industry to address critical challenges in global supply chain risk analysis. As the Program Manager, you will lead a small, specialized team to track and analyze trends, conduct in-depth technology assessments, respond to customer inquiries, and identify systemic vulnerabilities within the global microelectronics landscape.

:

Research and analyze publicly available data, including strategic planning, demand/capacity forecasts, regulatory considerations, safety and risk factors, and performance trends.

Identify opportunities for process improvement in gathering open-source microelectronics data and creating risk assessments.

Provide on-site client support as needed for inquiries, ad-hoc reporting, and guidance on analytical methods.

Proficient in business tools like Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

As a member of the CSP Engagements team, you will act as the primary technical engagement leader between NVIDIA’s system software organizations and CSP platform, system software, and AI teams, ensuring alignment, readiness, and successful large‑scale deployment of NVIDIA‑based datacenter solutions.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead deep technical engagements with hyperscale CSPs as the primary NVIDIA point of contact for system software, firmware, and platform readiness for NVIDIA datacenter products.
Partner directly with CSP system software, firmware, and infrastructure engineering leaders to align on software architecture, bring‑up plans, deployment readiness, and production requirements for NVIDIA‑based server and rack‑scale platforms.
Represent CSP technical priorities internally, advocating for customer requirements and tradeoffs across NVIDIA’s system software, firmware, hardware, silicon, and product teams are aligned to customer needs, timelines, and constraints.

Proactively identify and manage cross‑company technical risks affecting CSP deployments, including OS enablement, firmware maturity, observability, reliability, and hardware/software integration challenges.
Support rack‑scale and multi‑rack datacenter deployments by working closely with CSP infrastructure teams and NVIDIA engineering stakeholders to ensure system software readiness and operational success at hyperscale.

What We Need To See

This role requires strong technical depth and leadership credibility in systems software.

Strong background in systems or embedded software, with experience across Linux kernel/drivers, server firmware (BMC/BIOS/UEFI), or datacenter platform bring‑up and hardware/software interfaces.
Demonstrated technical leadership as a software engineering manager, technical lead/architect, or senior systems/platform engineer leading large cross‑functional efforts.

Experience working directly with hyperscale CSP engineering teams on deep technical topics, including bring up, performance, reliability, observability, and deployment readiness.
Strong ability to operate as a technical leader and influencer, aligning senior engineers, architects, and executives across organizational and company boundaries.
BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
10+ years of experience in systems software, embedded software, or datacenter server development, including leadership responsibility

Direct experience with NVIDIA GB200 and/or GB300 platforms, including hands‑on or leadership involvement in system software, firmware, or platform enablement efforts.
Experience driving or supporting CSP-facing engagements specifically for NVIDIA datacenter platforms, translating GB200 / GB300 software and firmware capabilities into production‑ready solutions.
Familiarity with the end‑to‑end NVIDIA data center software stack, including system software bring‑up, platform integration, observability, reliability, and deployment considerations at hyperscale.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Axon Community Connect enables public safety agencies to build voluntary, policy-based partnerships with businesses and community members. As the PSO Program Manager, Community Connect, you will lead the operational health and scalable execution of the Community Connect program across Axon’s U.S. customer base and growing international footprint.

You will serve as a program-level escalation resource, coordinating with Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Finance to remove blockers and drive resolution. You will also provide consultative support for hardware deployment readiness, remote hardware configuration and activation, connectivity, and camera integration requirements.

Maintain and improve customer-facing customer trust assets, including approved content, evidence packages, attestations, and trust-center materials.
Support the Nutanix Industrial Security Program compliance including assessments and implementation of controls against frameworks such as NIST 800-171 and/or CMMC.
Support complex customer security and compliance assessments, including questionnaires, evidence reviews, findings responses, and customer assurance discussions.
Review customer-facing security, privacy, compliance, and AI governance representations for accuracy, consistency, supportability, and alignment with approved certifications, attestations, policies, and control documentation.
Develop scalable processes, knowledge resources, and operating procedures to improve customer trust operations.
Manage outsourced customer trust analyst enablement, quality review, and continuous improvement efforts for outsourced assessment support.
Support strategic customer opportunities and complex diligence activities and partner with multiple Nutanix teams to coordinate cross-functional responses.
Track and communicate trends, recurring customer requirements, operational metrics, and areas for process improvement.
Partner with Sales, Legal, Product Security, Information Security, Privacy, Customer Support, and other stakeholders to support customer trust requirements.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, GRC, technology regulatory compliance/governance, technology risk, framework based compliance, or related fields.
U.S. Citizen and eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance if required to support government, defense, or other security-sensitive customer opportunities.
Experience supporting compliance and security for a technology company that sells to US Federal and Defense entities.
Experience supporting complex enterprise and public sector customer security assessments and customer due diligence activities including working knowledge of GRC portals and third party risk processes.
Direct experience providing program management for information security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, FedRAMP, SOC, ISO, CMMC, CSA Star, and a strong aptitude for learning regulatory requirements or new frameworks.
Experience participating in technical assessments and audits for a major compliance effort.
Ability to evaluate security documentation, certifications, policies, audit materials, and supporting evidence and translate these into controls applicable to customer requirements.
Build, maintain, and communicate detailed reporting and present findings to support decision-making and strategy.
Actively make recommendations for opportunities to collaborate more efficiently, scale processes using existing tools and systems, and own responsibility for implementing these solutions to help yield higher sales velocity, internal productivity, quality, and cost savings.
Ability to clearly identify, explain, and communicate progress, status, expectations, dependencies, and risks to executives, business partners and team members.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Experience working in a large, complex enterprise and partnering with Security, Legal, Privacy, Product and other stakeholders on commercial transactions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting compliance and security control maintenance for a US public technology company with a global distribution chain and operations.
Bachelor's degree in information technology, cybersecurity, risk management, or equivalent work experience.
Experience supporting industry participation in global defense programs.
Experience reviewing security and information technology contract terms.
Direct experience with technology system implementation, security for on-premise and hosted systems, and operations within an enclaved compliance environment.
Experience supporting global, regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or critical infrastructure.
CISSP, CIPT, CompTIA, or similar certifications.
Experience owning the management of GRC/Compliance tools, trust-center content, and vendor management.

Business Justification

Customer Trust has become an increasingly important revenue-enablement function as Nutanix expands within highly regulated and security-sensitive industries. Customer security and compliance assessment volume increased from 34 assessments in 2024 to 72 assessments in 2025 and more than 175 assessments as of September 30 2026. Customer requests are also becoming more complex, particularly in areas such as cybersecurity, AI governance, privacy, supply-chain risk, and regulatory compliance. Additionally, the Nutanix Industrial Security Program and related compliance frameworks that are mandatory to maintain are critical to selling into the US Federal/defense and global defense customer base.

Customer Trust currently relies on a limited number of resources to support rapidly growing customer diligence demands including time sensitive sales transactions that directly result in revenue. This new role is being added to provide additional support for customer assurance, cybersecurity governance, the Nutanix industrial security program, and enabling the Customer Trust program to scale more effectively against our global growth in customers and regulatory requirements.

Without additional capacity, Nutanix risks continuing to address a growing strategic workload through reactive, person-dependent processes rather than through a scalable and appropriately governed Customer Trust program.

Why a New Role Is Needed

This Role Will

Support complex and strategic customer diligence activities.
Improve the accuracy, consistency, and scalability of customer trust responses.
Scale, maintain and expand reusable customer trust assets and trust-center content and implement automation.
Increase the effectiveness of outsourced assessment support.
Provide deeper cybersecurity and GRC expertise for validating customer-facing security and compliance representations.
Help reduce transaction friction and support revenue-generating opportunities.

This is a new role created to provide additional capacity within the Customer Trust organization and to provide dedicated support for US Federal and global government sales as well as the Nutanix industrial security program. The role will have autonomy to accelerate automation and scalable customer practices using existing tools, and more efficient collaboration across cross-functional teams. It will also require experience with cybersecurity and compliance, independent judgment, program management, customer-facing assurance experience, and the ability to collaborate with the Customer Trust team to validate complex customer trust representations and supporting evidence.

Work Arrangement

This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration, Located in Durham, NC. For most roles, that will mean coming into an office a minimum of 2 - 3 days per week, however certain roles and/or teams may require more frequent in-office presence. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. This role is also available remotely.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $121,000 and USD $241,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

jobs.title: Sea Logistics Operational Key Account Manager - Program Manager
jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎

Are you passionate about transforming supply chains, driving operational excellence, and building long-term partnerships with global customers? Kuehne+Nagel is looking for a Sea Logistics Operational Key Account Manager (Program Manager) to join our Operational Key Account Management team.

In this role, you will serve as the operational leader and trusted advisor for one of our strategic customers, ensuring the successful delivery of complex ocean freight and supply chain solutions across the Americas. You will act as the bridge between customer expectations and operational execution, leveraging data, technology, and process improvement initiatives to drive performance, strengthen customer satisfaction, and unlock long-term supply chain value.

This is a highly visible role that requires a unique combination of operational expertise, program management capabilities, analytical thinking, and strong stakeholder management skills. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams across regions, influence senior stakeholders, and help shape the future of our customer's supply chain strategy.

How you create impact

Serve as the primary operational point of contact for strategic customer accounts, ensuring delivery against customer commitments and service expectations.
Develop and maintain strong customer relationships while acting as a trusted advisor and escalation point for operational matters.
Gain a comprehensive understanding of customer supply chains and become the operational subject matter expert for the assigned account.
Manage and coordinate complex ocean freight, order management, and supply chain programs across multiple countries and stakeholders.
Monitor operational performance through KPIs, dashboards, and reporting tools, ensuring service commitments are consistently achieved.
Analyze operational data and identify root causes of service disruptions, performance gaps, and process inefficiencies.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance visibility, efficiency, customer experience, and supply chain performance.
Collaborate with customer stakeholders, operational teams, customer care centers, transportation providers, and systems experts to execute customer-specific solutions.
Support implementation of new business, operational onboarding projects, process enhancements, and system integrations.
Utilize operational insights and customer intelligence to support commercial growth opportunities and strategic account development.
Create, maintain, and optimize standard operating procedures, governance processes, and documentation standards.
Facilitate business reviews and present operational performance, project updates, risks, and improvement opportunities to internal and external stakeholders.
Identify operational risks proactively and coordinate mitigation plans across the Kuehne+Nagel network.
Promote automation, digitalization, and process standardization initiatives to improve overall supply chain effectiveness.
Act as a strategic partner in developing long-term supply chain value roadmaps and continuous improvement programs for the customer.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

What we would like you to bring

5+ years of experience in Sea Logistics, Freight Forwarding, Supply Chain Management, Operational Key Account Management, Program Management, or Order Management environments.
Strong understanding of ocean freight operations, global supply chains, transportation management, and customer fulfillment processes.
Experience managing strategic customer relationships and leading customer-facing operational reviews with senior stakeholders.
Proven ability to interpret operational data, manage KPIs, conduct root cause analysis, and drive measurable process improvements.
Experience with Order Management, Control Tower, Supply Chain Visibility, TMS, ERP, or similar logistics technologies; experience with Nexus or comparable platforms is highly desirable.
Demonstrated project or program management experience within complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across all organizational levels.
Strong analytical mindset combined with a proactive, solution-oriented approach to problem solving.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.
Experience supporting retail, consumer goods, footwear, apparel, or other high-volume import supply chains is considered an advantage.

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel we strive daily to inspire, empower, and deliver not only to our customers, but also to our colleagues. We offer a dynamic global work environment with opportunities for excellent training programs and career mobility. The target base salary range for this position is between $90,000 and $100,000. Base salary is part of a competitive total rewards package that includes health and welfare benefits, a 401k retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, and incentive compensation for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, skills, job location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Kuehne+Nagel reviews pay ranges regularly to ensure competitive and fair pay based on industry market data.

Kuehne+Nagel participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used to assist in specific processes [e.g. screening applications, interview scheduling]. These tools analyze information to support decision-making, but final decisions are made by human reviewers.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

Kuehne+Nagel is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (“EEO”) and to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful retaliation. Kuehne+Nagel strictly prohibits all discrimination on the basis of race, ancestry, color, age, national origin, ethnicity, religious creed or belief, physical or mental disability, marital or familial status, legally protected medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), gender (including gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, citizenship status, protected activity (such as opposition to or reporting of prohibited discrimination or harassment. Kuehne+Nagel will also make reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees, including accommodations for pregnancy and childbirth, and for the sincerely held religious beliefs of applicants and employees depending upon individual circumstances unless such accommodation would create an undue hardship on Kuehne+Nagel.

jobs.title: Senior Federal Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Health Government Services is seeking a skilled Senior Federal Project Manager to join our mission-drive organization. In this role, you will be responsible for leading program activities to ensure the successful delivery of large, complex federal task orders. As a project management professional and leading contributor, you will provide high-quality operational and project management support to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual requirements. This role requires the ability to independently assess priorities, oversee project activities, and maintain alignment with key program objectives. Working closely with federal customers, delivery teams, and program leadership, you will help manage customer expectations, minimize risk, and ensure project deliverables consistently meet or exceed quality standards.

You will provide strategic operations support by coordinating with stakeholders, preparing leadership and customer-facing materials, facilitating meetings, tracking action items, and maintaining alignment across multiple workstreams. You will analyze business needs and apply Oracle methodologies, policies, industry best practices, and product knowledge to help ensure solutions align with customer objectives. The ideal candidate is a dynamic, results-driven project manager who is highly organized, possesses strong communication and business acumen, and thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Responsibilities

Support the Task Order Owner and/or Lead Project Manager in managing the tasks required for the end-to-end contractual delivery of large, complex task orders.
Manage the scope of large-scale, multi-site task orders with varying levels of complexity ensuring adherence to scope/contractual delivery and financial commitments in accordance with the Task Order Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Price Schedule.
Monitor the Integrated Master Schedule for updates to identify potential delays or lack of progress, including follow-ups with the delivery team.
Create/update presentations for internal and customer-facing performance meetings, project management reviews, status reports, and other briefings as needed.
Lead internal and external project meetings, providing updates on progress and milestones, key operational and financial measures and risks assessments.
Facilitate consistent communication between internal stakeholders to ensure project requirements, deadlines, priorities and decisions are aligned and clearly understood.
Support and monitor 3 rd party supplier contracts ensuring alignment to scope and resourcing needs.
Monitor, analyze, and report on staffing levels, forecast hours, project actuals, and variances. Identifies root cause of variances exceeding the allowed threshold and works to remediate.
Support continuous process improvement efforts through capture and resolution of lessons learned.
Manage the creation and updates of contractual deliverables by coordinating with subject matter experts and content owners, ensuring deliverables are high-quality, complete and acceptable to the client.
Initiate and gather details for Work at Risk approvals.
Proactively identify and track project risks, develop mitigation plans, establish and support escalation and communication pathways for project-related issues.
Maintain strong relationships with the delivery team and VA PM.
Communicate information to project team members ensuring they are equipped with specifics to the project logistics, project numbers and other pertinent information.
Support invoice review/approval.
Provide direction and mentoring to delivery teams and fellow team members.
Support travel expense auditing and approvals, ensuring expense submissions comply with GSA rate(s) and other expense policies.
Support data calls as requested by Task Order leadership.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Academic Flourishing Initiative (AFI), Human Flourishing Program
jobs.description:
Company Description

By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Why join the Harvard Faculty of Arts and Sciences?

The Faculty of Arts and Sciences (FAS) is the historic heart of Harvard University. It is the home of Harvard’s undergraduate program (Harvard College, founded in 1636) as well as all of Harvard’s Ph.D. programs (the Harvard Kenneth C. Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, founded in 1872), Harvard Athletics and the Division of Continuing Education. The 40 academic departments and 30+ centers of the FAS support a community unparalleled in its academic excellence across the broadest range of liberal arts and sciences disciplines. Together, the FAS seeks to foster an environment of ambition, curiosity and shared commitment to knowledge and truth that elicits excellence from all members of our community and prepares the next generation of leaders through a transformative educational experience.

Job Description

Job Summary:

The Human Flourishing Program at Harvard's Institute for Quantitative Social Science (HFH) aims to study and promote human flourishing, and to develop systematic approaches to the synthesis of knowledge across disciplines.

As part of this mission, the Program has launched a series of initiatives focused on making impact and advancing human flourishing out into the world. The recently launched initiative, the Academic Flourishing Initiative (AFI), focuses on using the flourishing measure to assess if colleges and universities are achieving their vision and mission statements -- which typically aspire to transform students into intellectually capable and virtuous leaders of society. A number of member colleges and universities participate as members of the AFI data collaborative which is a major source of revenue for AFI. The first year included 19 institutions.

The Program Manager position is responsible for the oversight, development, and growth of the AFI Initiative. This position reports to the Associate Director for Research and works closely with the Executive Director and the Director of HFH. The Program Manager liaises with IQSS Business Operations team as needed on administrative, financial, and HR related activities. The position also engages with leaders of colleges and universities for recruitment, onboarding, and sharing of reports.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Develop the structure and strategy for AFI.

Working closely with Director, Executive Director, and Associate Director for Research, create strategy and five year plan.
Develop strategy to create optimal portfolio for types of institutions in addition to how to best communicate findings and advance flourishing in these institutions.

High-level recruitment
and engagement of current and prospect members of the AFI data collaborative, often at the president or provost level.

Lead recruitment efforts including discussions with leadership of prospect institutions.
Develop and execute engagement, communications and marketing plan.
Oversee high-level gatherings such as large group sessions with member institution leadership, recruitment events, and sessions to promote findings and opportunities.
Develop content and materials for these efforts.
Onboarding process for member institutions.
Development of Data Use Agreement with institutions and interface with Harvard OGC and OSP for that purpose.

AFI revenue strategy development and oversight.

Development and execution of revenue models and strategies for AFI.
Discussions with institutions regarding revenue opportunities.
Fundraising efforts with donors and prospects.
Management of invoices and payment systems with regards to member institutions. Includes engagement with both members and Harvard finance.
Serve as primary AFI administrative liaison for HFH with IQSS finance administrators with regards to revenue activity.

Research report development and engagement with institutions.

Development of reports and findings for individual institutions and across institutions.
Engagement with institution research teams.
Engagement with HFH researchers.
Engagement with academic humility and academic freedom activity.

Lead communications activities for AFI.

Develop key communications messages for AFI.
Website development and oversight.
Press engagement.
Development of AFI collateral.
Development of other AFI media including videos.
Work closely with HFH Communications Manager.

Management of AFI administrative processes.

Recruit, interview, hire, train, and supervise AFI staff, student workers, and temporary personnel; assign and review work; provide ongoing feedback and coaching; and conduct annual employee performance reviews.
Serve as primary administrative AFI liaison for HFH with IQSS Business Operations team, affiliated faculty and researchers, staff and visitors; resolve operational issues and escalate complex matters as needed.
Develop and maintain internal tracking systems to ensure AFI activities are implemented on time and within scope.

Financial oversight
and management of day-to-day financial operations for AFI including budgeting and developing and managing systems that track finances, invoicing systems, purchasing systems, and other financial processes.

Developing budget, financial systems, and processes.
Entering, tracking and reconciling invoices, reimbursements, purchasing card transactions, and vendor payments in Harvard financial systems.
Monitoring AFI budget and research funding in collaboration with the IQSS Finance teams.
Preparing regular financial reports.
Flagging variances, or potential overruns, and recommends adjustments as needed.
Ensuring compliance with Harvard, FAS, IQSS, and financial policies.

Working Conditions:

Work Setting: Office.
Travel Requirements: about 15%, local and/or national.
This is a hybrid position with an expectation of working on campus three days per week. Exact schedule will be determined in conjunction with your manager and may adjust based on operational and/or business needs.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 5 years of related experience, preferably in educational and/or social impact leadership.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

3+ years of project and academic administration experience.
Master's and/or PhD in related field.

Additional Information

Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week
Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education, Criminal
Other Information:

This is a one-year term appointment from the date of hire, with the possibility of extension.
All formal offers will be made by FAS Human Resources.
All applicants must submit a cover letter to be considered for this position.
IQSS sits in the Division of Social Science. At IQSS, respect and fairness, kindness and collegiality, and trust and transparency are among the values we espouse and promote in our workplace culture. We work hard to ensure a healthy, inclusive, and positive environment where everyone does their best work in support of Harvard’s mission.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 057. Please visit  Harvard's Salary Ranges  to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

Generous paid time off including parental leave
Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
Retirement plans with university contributions
Wellbeing and mental health resources
Support for families and caregivers
Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Amazon Connect is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them.

See our section in Andy Jassy 2020 re:Invent keynote

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. We are looking for passionate and talented Technical Program Manager to join us to innovate on this new service that addresses customer needs to build modern contact centers in the cloud. The position represents a rare opportunity to be a part of a fast-growing business soon after launch, and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

We are looking for a highly effective Senior Technical Program Manager that can lead a team to quickly design and deliver systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

You will be key leader responsible for delivering the distributed systems and analytics that will enable AWS to continue changing the software industry by delivering more capabilities to more customers.

You enjoy working with a fun team that prides itself on a great work environment with an inclusive group of people that are working together towards a common goal.

Partners with senior management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services. Shapes and leads technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues. Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals. Provides expert technical guidance to shape and direct the automation of comprehensive reporting, leading collaboration with development teams to drive innovations in reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for long-term technical program execution. Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams for high-impact technical programs.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Designs and shapes the strategy for product or service delivery, ensuring alignment with the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Integrates program demands and resourcing.

– Leads rapid response to the most critical security escalations, coordinating across teams and departments and serving as the primary point of contact to executives to assess risk, determine comprehensive mitigation strategies, and ensure alignment and execution of the most effective path to resolution.

– Leads the transformation and optimization of processes to ensure the highest reliability and resilience of products or services.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Shapes overall planning activities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture.

– Defines and enforces delivery standards and guidelines, ensuring security, scalability, and alignment with best practices.

– Develops Line of Business (LOB) strategies for change management and/or incident response to enhance operational efficiency.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Leads the alignment of priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.

– Leads efforts to define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for LOB performance.

– Develops and communicates a comprehensive and strategic communication strategy of highly complex objectives to partners and customers.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Shapes and leads both technical and non-technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides and mentors program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success), providing expert technical support and strategic direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Provides guidance on developing and maintaining comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and develops risk mitigation strategies.

– Ensures attention to detail, including security and quality, in program management, from planning to execution and reporting.

– Chairs regular program status meetings, fostering collaboration and driving effective communication across teams and leaders.

– Partners with leadership to set service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity benchmarks aligned with long-term business goals.

– Shapes and leads forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Leads the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, development, requirement changes, and support.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues.

– Develops plans based on the results of cost assessments, benefits analysis, and return on investment (ROI) to improve decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Makes strategic decisions, balancing business needs, technical constraints, and long-term goals.

– Removes critical blockers for the program and determines optimal technical and resource options to drive the successful delivery and adoption of solutions.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across the LOB.

– Leads the development and optimization of program objectives and workflows, while orchestrating the deployment of cross-functional solutions to address complex business problems.

– Collaborates with management to innovate and optimize processes and procedures to drive achievement of LOB goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Champions LOB-wide integration of continuous improvement within programs, ensuring alignment of insights across many workstreams with business objectives and operational efficiency goals.

– Establishes and champions best practices for leveraging data insights at scale, influencing senior leadership decisions.

– Leads the development of innovative business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Shapes collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals.

– Leads process improvements across the LOB, working with senior leaders to implement team-wide efficiency-driven solutions.

– Communicates strategic program updates and insights to leadership teams, shaping decisions at the LOB level.

– Develops and refines engagement approaches for key stakeholders, ensuring informed decision-making at scale to improve program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Shapes and leads programs to optimize organizational efficiency.

– Provides visionary technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Drives transformative change at all levels of the LOB, from initiation through delivery, while ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

– Shapes and directs the automation of comprehensive reporting, collaborating with development teams to drive continuous improvement of reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for program execution.

– Utilizes data insights to solve highly complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

– Conducts analysis on a large number of data sources with high complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement:

– Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts across stakeholder teams for high-impact programs.

– Serves as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment between program priorities and business objectives.

– Defines strategies for enhancing customer engagement, aligning service offerings with evolving business needs.

– Drives large-scale product and process enhancements, influencing and guiding the LOB.

– Develops and presents advanced strategies to mitigate risks to customer satisfaction, assessing the impact of mitigation efforts on broader group objectives.

– Leads the alignment of varied priorities and Oracle commitments, ensuring optimal coverage and response to customer needs, minimizing organizational risk to programs.

Planning & Execution:

Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager | Cloud Infrastructure & Migration
jobs.description:
Description

About the Role

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at NinjaOne, you will own the programs that take us from a single-cloud service on AWS to a multi-cloud platform. You will lead the work of standing up and operating production environments on GCP, Azure, and other major providers, and you will drive the migration of workloads across them. You will join a newly formed team and run complex, multi-threaded programs from concept to delivery across Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Security, and Product. You will map technical dependencies, mitigate risk, and keep stakeholders informed through high-signal reporting.

This role is for someone who has done it before. You have been accountable for standing up a multi-cloud environment or migrating production workloads off a single cloud, and you can hold your own with architects on what that takes.

Location

We are flexible on remote work if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states: CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OR, TN, TX, VA, OH, and WA. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL if you prefer a hybrid option.

Onsite interviews may be required for this role.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead cloud migration and multi-cloud programs: Own end-to-end delivery of programs that stand up new cloud environments and migrate production workloads, including data, services, networking, identity, and observability. Define cutover strategies, rollback plans, and success criteria.
Outline program goals: Define goals and deliverables for each initiative, and build alignment and shared vision within the working group. Partner with Engineering leaders to translate technical constraints into requirements or acceptable workarounds.
Coordinate across teams: Work with Development, QA, SRE, DevOps, Security, and Senior Leadership through weekly reviews and status checkpoints. Understand the full product delivery cycle and where cloud changes touch it.
Manage complexity and dependencies: Build and maintain project plans, dependency charts, and a risk register. Manage multiple concurrent workstreams without losing sight of the critical path. Report through Executive Summaries and Detailed Status updates.
Measure and instrument: Define what "great" looks like for each program and make it measurable. Establish baselines (for example, migration progress, cost, latency, availability, and delivery metrics), instrument them, and use them to surface problems early rather than to narrate progress.
Manage risk and stakeholders: Identify technical, resource, cost, and compliance risks early, own mitigation strategies, and report transparently to senior leadership. Run audits, checkpoints, and milestone reviews.
Drive change management: Anticipate and manage change through impact assessment, communication, and timely decisions.
Influence and resolve conflict: Build trust-based relationships across the organization, bring options to the table, and drive consensus so programs keep moving.
Other duties as needed.

About You

Cloud program experience (hard requirement): You have led, as the accountable TPM or program owner, at least one of the following in a production SaaS environment:
Standing up a multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environment, or
Migrating a production workload from a single cloud to another cloud or to a multi-cloud architecture.

8+ years in Technical Program Management at a SaaS company, working within an Engineering team.
Working knowledge of hyperscaler services (AWS required, plus Azure and/or GCP), including compute, storage, networking, IAM, and managed databases, sufficient to hold your own in architecture and design discussions.
Experience with large-scale datastore, stateful-workload, or data migrations, including cutover planning, validation, and rollback.
Experience with release engineering, CI/CD, or deployment automation. You have improved how software ships, not only what ships.
Experience delivering programs in a regulated or audited environment (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or similar). You work within change-control and evidence-collection processes rather than around them.
Track record of defining and instrumenting delivery metrics (DORA, flow metrics, or equivalent) and using them to drive decisions.
Strong grounding in Agile, Scrum, and release management.
Ability to explain technology and program status clearly to audiences from engineers to executives.
Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and to define details without supervision.
Experience collaborating with global teams in fully remote cultures and managing task accountability.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. We are collaborative, fast-moving, and succinct, and our communication style matches.
Power-user proficiency in JIRA, with optimized workflows, accurate reporting data, and a single source of truth for project activity.
Bachelor's in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or an equivalent technical field. Relevant work experience will also be considered.

Strongly Preferred

Experience with cloud cost management (FinOps) during or after a migration.
Experience with data residency, sovereignty, or gov-cloud requirements.
Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar), and cross-cloud networking or identity federation.
Experience with Java, Kotlin, Golang, or Postgres-based platforms.
Cyber security or engineering leadership experience on a SaaS platform.

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You'll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.
We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.
We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.
We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.
We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.
We reward your work with opportunities for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey, or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000-$225,000 per year.

For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000-$225,000 per year.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Blockchain Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The company is a leading blockchain infrastructure company building technology that connects blockchains with real-world data, traditional systems, and other blockchain networks. They support applications across decentralized finance, tokenized assets, interoperability, and other onchain use cases.

We are looking for an experienced Project / Program Manager
with 5+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in technology, software, fintech, blockchain, or a similarly fast-moving environment.

This role is suited to a delivery-focused programme professional who can operate strategically while maintaining strong attention to execution. You will work across engineering, product, business development, operations, commercial, and other functions to turn strategic objectives into well-defined programmes and measurable outcomes.

You will be expected to bring structure to ambiguity, manage complex dependencies, engage confidently with senior stakeholders, identify and mitigate delivery risks, and create the operating rhythm required to deliver programmes successfully.

The Role

As a Project / Program Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of strategic and cross-functional initiatives.

You will operate as a central point of coordination across multiple teams, ensuring that programme objectives, priorities, dependencies, risks, resources, and timelines remain aligned.
The successful candidate will be comfortable working in an environment where requirements can evolve rapidly and where programmes may involve highly technical subject matter. You should be able to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders without needing to be the technical subject-matter expert.

You will be expected to lead through influence rather than authority
, establish clarity in ambiguous situations, and ensure that teams remain focused on outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
Programme Leadership
Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of complex, cross-functional programmes.
Translate strategic objectives into clear programme goals, roadmaps, milestones, deliverables, and success measures.
Establish programme governance, operating rhythms, decision-making processes, and reporting structures.
Coordinate multiple interconnected projects and workstreams to ensure alignment against overall programme objectives.
Manage programme dependencies across engineering, product, operations, commercial, legal, finance, and other functions.
Identify opportunities to simplify, sequence, or restructure initiatives to improve delivery outcomes.
Ensure programmes remain aligned with organisational priorities as requirements and circumstances evolve.

Delivery & Execution
Drive execution against agreed milestones, outcomes, budgets, and timelines.
Maintain appropriate programme plans, roadmaps, RAID logs, dependency maps, and decision registers.
Establish clear ownership and accountability across programme workstreams.
Identify delivery risks and issues early, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate appropriately.
Remove blockers by coordinating the appropriate stakeholders and decision-makers.
Monitor programme health and intervene when delivery is at risk.
Lead retrospectives and post-programme reviews to identify lessons learned and improve future delivery.
Establish and continuously improve project and programme management practices across the organisation.

Stakeholder Management
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and functional leaders.
Provide concise, transparent, and actionable programme reporting to leadership.
Facilitate difficult conversations around priorities, dependencies, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
Ensure decisions are made at the appropriate level and clearly communicated to affected teams.
Translate complex technical or operational information into clear business-level insights.
Align stakeholders with different objectives around common programme outcomes.
Act as a trusted delivery partner to programme sponsors and senior leadership.

Strategic Planning
Partner with leadership to define programme objectives, priorities, scope, and measures of success.
Support portfolio-level planning and prioritisation.
Identify cross-programme dependencies, resource constraints, and strategic risks.
Develop programme roadmaps that balance strategic ambition with realistic execution.
Use data, metrics, and stakeholder feedback to assess programme performance and inform decisions.
Help shape organisational processes and operating models as the company scales.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience
5+ years of professional experience in project management, programme management, product operations, consulting, technology delivery, or a related discipline.

Demonstrable experience leading complex, cross-functional programmes from initiation through delivery.
Experience working with engineering, product, technology, or other highly technical teams.
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and dependencies simultaneously.
Experience operating with senior leadership and providing executive-level programme reporting.
Strong understanding of programme governance, risk management, dependency management, and delivery methodologies.
Demonstrable experience managing ambiguity and bringing structure to complex or evolving initiatives.
Demonstrable analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
Track record of influencing and driving outcomes without direct line-management authority.
Experience operating in a remote, distributed, and international organisation.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

Desirable Experience

Experience within blockchain, Web3, fintech, financial services, SaaS, infrastructure, or emerging technology.
Experience working within Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery environments.
Experience with programme portfolio management.
Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, Asana, or equivalent platforms.
Formal project/programme management qualification such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, AgilePM, Scrum, or equivalent is a plus
Working knowledge of blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, DeFi, tokenization, interoperability, or Web3.

Leadership & Working Style

We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with exceptional execution
.
Creates clarity from ambiguity

You are comfortable entering situations where the objectives, ownership, requirements, or timelines are not yet fully defined. You bring structure, ask the right questions, establish accountability, and create a practical path forward.
Takes ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply managing tasks. You proactively identify risks, address issues, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
Leads through influence

You can bring together senior stakeholders, engineers, product leaders, and business teams around a common objective without relying on formal authority.
Communicates with precision

You know what different stakeholders need to know and can communicate complex information clearly, concisely, and appropriately for the audience.
Thinks strategically

You understand the relationship between individual projects and broader organisational objectives. You can move between detailed execution and high-level strategic thinking.
Challenges constructively

You are willing to challenge assumptions, question existing processes, and raise difficult issues when doing so improves the programme outcome.
Remains adaptable

The blockchain and technology landscape evolves rapidly. You can adjust plans when circumstances change while maintaining clarity around the underlying objectives.

Measures of Success

Success in this role will be demonstrated through your ability to:
Successfully deliver complex programmes against agreed strategic objectives.
Establish clear accountability across multiple teams and workstreams.
Maintain strong programme visibility for senior leadership.
Identify and mitigate material risks before they become critical delivery issues.
Resolve complex cross-functional dependencies and unblock teams.
Improve predictability, transparency, and quality of programme delivery.
Build strong relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Develop scalable programme-management practices as the organisation grows.
Create measurable improvements in programme outcomes, operational efficiency, or organisational capability.
Become a trusted strategic delivery partner to senior leaders and programme sponsors.

What You Will Bring

You will bring the maturity to operate independently, the programme-management expertise to lead complex initiatives, and the curiosity to understand highly technical subject matter.
You don't need to be a blockchain engineer. You do need to be comfortable working alongside highly technical teams, asking intelligent questions, understanding dependencies and risks, and translating complex information into decisions and actions.
Most importantly, you will be someone who can connect strategy to execution
— turning ambitious objectives into clear plans, aligning teams around those plans, and driving delivery through to measurable outcomes.

At PwC, our people in software and product innovation focus on developing cutting-edge software solutions and driving product innovation to meet the evolving needs of clients. These individuals combine technical experience with creative thinking to deliver innovative software products and solutions.

Those in software engineering at PwC will focus on developing innovative software solutions to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.

Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system.

Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.

Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.

Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same.

Effectively mentor others.

BAE Systems is hiring a Program Manager III for our Combat Mission Systems (CMS) business in Louisville, KY. The program manager will be responsible for managing and delivering on our commitments in our Propulsor portfolio and is directly responsible for profit and loss on the highly complex programs. Provide a competitive advantage to the company by managing all the program's defined scope on schedule, within budget, and at the expected level of quality. This role primarily manages contracts and new business with existing customers. The role reports directly to the Director for Submarine Programs.

Location/Schedule/Travel:

This role is onsite in Louisville, KY
The workday will begin around 7:00AM
The role works on a 9/80 schedule where you will have every other Friday off
There may be up to 10% domestic travel

The Program Manager Is Accountable For The Following

Managing program execution to predictably achieve cost/profitability, schedule, and technical performance objectives
