new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Suvi, an Akima Company, is looking for a Program Manager to lead program for a mission-oriented Law Enforcement organization in the National Capital Region. This individual will serve as the contract main point of contact to the Government stakeholders and an advisor on matters related to delivering scientific and engineering capabilities to organizations and operational users. The responsibilities also include leading or supporting key initiatives to assist the client and/or Compass Point to identify opportunities and maximize value gained from proven and new investigative technologies.

To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary point-of-contact for the client agency for all matters pertaining to the contract. Must be readily accessible to the COR via telephone, email, and in person. Will work closely with the COR to ensure the attainment of all contract goals and objectives, as well as successful implementation of day–to-day activities.
Provide overall direction of program activities and personnel.
Responsible for program oversight, budgeting, planning and scheduling, progress reporting, earned value, performance analysis, technical risk analysis, financial planning, quality assurance and quality control, and delivery of services.
Provide program leadership to assigned project teams and monitor assigned project managers to ensure that appropriate technical and administrative personnel are assigned to the program.
Manage contract functional area or business line programs that are sensitive or critical in nature, broad in scope and impact, and significant in terms of company-committed resources.
Provide senior interface between client and company resources and manager assigned programs to meet client requirements.
Work with the client and company leadership to assist in establishing policy and strategic direction for programs.
Communicate with senior levels of the client on a frequent basis.
Ensure client satisfaction with company performance.
Support corporate initiatives, proposals, and business development efforts as requested.

Qualifications

US Citizenship required with an ability to obtain Public Trust / pass DEA agency-specific background check.
Active DoD Secret clearance desired (an ability to obtain and maintain up to DoD Top Secret clearance strongly desired).
Minimum of 10 years of related technical and managerial experience (A Master's degree substitutes for two years' experience and a Ph.D. will substitute for 5 years' experience).
Ability to manage complex program activities and act as customer liaison for program progress reports.
Must have a BA/BS in technical or business discipline.
Strong management and relationship building skills.
Experience of Government or non-Government organizations in managing international development assistance projects is preferred but not required.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills (written and verbal) with experience briefing senior federal executives.

Any clearance requirements for this position are established by the government contract.

Job ID

2026-26342

Work Type

On-Site

Pay Range

$130,000 - $140,000

Benefits

Regular - The company offers a comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) and a range of other voluntary benefits. Paid Time Off (PTO) is offered to regular full-time and part-time employees.

Company Description

Work Where it Matters

Suvi, an Akima company, is not just another federal mission services contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At Suvi, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

For our shareholders
, Suvi provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

For our government customers
, Suvi delivers subject matter experts, an agile management approach, and innovative technologies that accomplish customers’ missions safely, securely, and efficiently.

As a Suvi employee
, you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

new_jobs.description:
Location: Austin, United States of America

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Position Summary

Austin, Hybrid

As a Technical Project Manager
for the Identity and Biometrics Solutions team, you will deliver solutions that meet external customer requirements and Thales’ commitments.

The Technical Project Manager manages and coordinates internal (Control Account Managers, Work Package Managers, developers, engineers, etc.) and external (customers, suppliers, sub-contractors, partners, etc.) dedicated teams by involving the following associated teams: Sales, finance, contract management, etc.

In this role, you will direct the project activities (including those relating to risks & opportunities) to ensure projects are delivered on-time, within budget, satisfy technical requirements, and meet customer expectations. This responsibility is exercised from signature of the contract through to the project completion period in terms of organization, time frame, workload, budget, etc.

The Identity and Biometrics Solutions team is responsible for the design and development of highly innovative components and products, from desktop applications integrating various hardware (biometric devices integration) to high performance server applications, including issuance of official documents in a very secure environment (PKI, encryption, cryptography), and leading the transformation to Digital Driver’s Licenses.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements

Must have U.S. Citizenship in order to obtain the post-hire Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Clearance from the Federal Bureau of Investigation and must be able to obtain post-hire clearance from the Committee on Foreign Investments in the U.S. (CFIUS) and Department of Justice.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Establish and update project requirements baseline in a collaborative work with the Bid Manager and the Capture Leader
Establish and update project execution baseline (project structure, work package description, partners and supplier contractual data, management plans, costs, budgets and financial structure, resourced schedule, risks and mitigations)
Lead customer interactions for the project
Lead the project launch review and involves all stakeholders: project team, Management Plan and associated documents (WBS, OBS, schedule, budget allocations…), industrial scenario, project charter, team charter
Manage legal and contractual requirements including handling disputes
Conduct regular progress review meetings, reporting the project progress to the company senior management
Close the project (archiving of documents, closing of the expenditure authorizations) by capitalizing and sharing onenterprise experience (lessons learnt)
Coordinate across teams for prioritization, resource allocation, risk identification and mitigation, and issue resolution.
Monitor project variances; preparing EAC (Estimate at Completion) review slides and presenting to management.
Present monthly project dash board with project financials, project KPIs like variance and contingencies
Drive the project to ensure customer satisfaction by meeting deadlines, quality specifications, and project profitability
Build project schedule and cost baseline and update project forecast regularly (at-least every month)
Work closely with the PM Team Manager, Engineering, IT, Security and Operations ensuring clear communication, business based prioritization, and definition of precise scope and planning
Cultivate and maintain strong partnerships with decision-makers across operations groups (PMO, Procurement, Supply Chain, Data Center, Quality, Software Development and Validation, Manufacturing, Logistics and Ops Finance) to build and continuously improve process to ensure high quality and on-time delivery
Must ensure compliance of Thales, Customer, Security and all applicable regulations individually and for the project(s)

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or similar field
PMP certification with 5 years of experience in technical/ engineering project management
Prior experience communicating pertinent and technical information to external customers and other stakeholders on a regular basis
Prior experience managing scope and requirements autonomously
Proven experience with PM tools – Confluence, JIRA or equivalent, building project schedules with Microsoft Project, and performing risk management activities such as project cost forecasting, measurement of project cost variance, developing and monitoring project risk contingencies and adherence to KPI’s
Proven track record with change management- planning for the various stages of transformational, transitional change, recognizing how people react to it and how it affects the organization
Technical understanding of multi-tier enterprise solution in a complex environment using software development (SDLC) - within Thales that translates to: front end, back end, data centers, deployment across locations, hardware deployment, software issues, network to and from locations, and disaster recovery –which are all part of the project

Travel
: 25% (up to 40%) of the time domestically during the specification and integration phases and for workshops

The Opportunity

As a Cybersecurity, Privacy and Forensics - Data Protection - PKI Implementation Manager, you will specialize in providing advice and guidance to clients on privacy laws and data protection regulations. You will help businesses navigate the complex landscape of privacy and data protection requirements, confirming compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Working in this area, you will assist in developing privacy policies, conducting privacy impact assessments, and implementing data protection measures to safeguard personal information. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations.

In this role, you will be part of our Cybersecurity & Privacy network within our Cyber, Data & Tech Risk practice. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.

Responsibilities

Leading the implementation of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) solutions to enhance data protection measures
Guiding clients through privacy laws and data protection regulations to confirm compliance with applicable standards
Conducting privacy impact assessments and developing comprehensive privacy policies
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address cybersecurity challenges and data breach incidents
Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for improved data security
Taking ownership of projects, managing planning, budgeting, execution, and completion phases
Coaching team members to leverage their strengths and deliver on client expectations
Engaging in strategic questioning to identify opportunities for enhancing privacy program development
Reviewing legal documents and providing legal advice to support compliance with data protection laws
Upholding professional and technical standards, including the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 4 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Communications/Media, Computer Science/Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Government/Public Policy, Law/Legal Studies, Mathematics/Statistics, Project/Technology Management, Risk Management/Insurance, Marketing
Demonstrating proficiency in cybersecurity and privacy regulations
Utilizing analytical thinking to solve complex data protection challenges
Excelling in coaching and mentoring team members
Developing privacy program strategies for client engagements
Embracing change and innovation in data risk management
Navigating legal compliance in data protection and privacy

Our Digital Modernization Division is an information technology and management consulting department that offers integrated, strategic solutions to its public and private-sector clients. Guide the management of a variety of SaaS technology platforms. Work with technical leadership and other architects to develop and promote technology best practices, and standards, and collaborate with other service delivery teams. Develop an understanding of the client processes and procedures and assist with making improvements relative to technology.
Work with a team of senior technologists to lead and manage the rapid development and implementation of prototypes and proofs-of-concept utilizing a variety of technologies.
Understand and identify requirements by establishing personal rapport with clients and with other persons in a position to understand service requirements.
Document project plans, architecture diagrams, and processes.

4+ years of Federal experience

In-depth understanding of ServiceNow best practices and industry trends

Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

new_jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What You'll Do At Jamf

The Project Manager II will manage and provide visibility into key projects, including customer-facing and/or internal projects. They will be adept at working cross-functionally, with teams as well as with other departments. This role will coordinate people and processes to ensure that our projects are delivered on time and produce the desired results.The Project Manager II will be the go-to person for everything involving a project’s organization, timeline, and reporting. This will include working with stakeholders to set deadlines, assign responsibilities, and monitor and provide updates regarding the status of projects.

The ability to lead projects of all sizes, coordinate, implement best practices, create and manage centralized dashboards, and communicate issues/risks/team progress will be critical to success.

What you can expect to do in this role:

Responsible for the alignment, coordination, and communication of projects including releases, integrations, and migrations, rollout of new tooling, and other projects as needed to support the Jamf portfolio.
Drive and coordinate tasks/ dependencies/ roadblocks across the Jamf portfolio.
Develop detailed project plans to monitor and track progress
Independently conduct project intake and requirements sessions in order to define project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders
Own changes to the project scope, schedule, and costs with a communication plan to stakeholders.
Assist with facilitating stakeholder alignment/status meetings & portfolio communication.
Escalate issues/risks/decisions to management.
As change occurs, new issues arise or scope increases:
Gather and communicate dependencies/impacts.
Facilitate trade-off conversations with stakeholders and project teams.

Coordinate change control for changes within our tooling across the Jamf Portfolio.
Create weekly centralized dashboards to communicate issues/risks/stats.
Support an organizational culture that fosters quality, collaboration, high morale, and productivity.
Ensure resource availability and assist with coordination of resources
Establish and maintain relationships with third parties/vendors and internal stakeholders pertaining to scope, timeline, or resources.
Be an active member of the PMO team by attending trainings and team meetings, and support other team members as needed.
Provide mentorship to other Project Managers

What we are looking for:

Minimum of 2 years of project management experience (Required)
Working knowledge of JIRA, Confluence (Preferred)
Scrum and/or agile training (Preferred)
Working knowledge of Aha!, Domo, Salesforce, Monday.com (PD&D Preferred)
Working knowledge of ServiceNow SPM and/or other Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) tools. (ETO Preferred)
Experience managing external vendor relationships (Preferred)
Self-starter with excellent business/financial acumen

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

High School Diploma / GED equivalent (Required)
4 year / bachelor's degree (Preferred)
PMP, PRINCE II PMP, CAPM or equivalent certification (Preferred)
A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

How we help you reach your best potential:

Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf
We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$90,000—$130,000 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?

We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?

Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. new_jobs.description:
Job Description

As a Customer Experience Program Management Manager here at Honeywell, you will have the opportunity to shape the customer experience strategy and drive initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. You will report directly to our Director Customer Experience Program Management, and you’ll work out of our West Region location.

Honeywell Building Solutions installs, integrates, and maintains building systems that help customers operate connected, safe, secure, comfortable, productive, and cost-efficient facilities. The Services business is evolving toward a balanced portfolio of traditional field services, connected services, remote delivery, software-enabled offerings, and data-driven operational solutions.

The Regional Operations Leader is responsible for leading the Operations organization within an assigned region. The position has an end-to-end accountability for regional service operations execution
, including Service Contracts, SPOT and Service Projects, operational planning, financial performance, cash, capacity, process discipline, data quality, and deployment of productivity and digital initiatives.

Role

The Regional Operations Leader serves as the primary operational partner to the Regional General Manager, Regional Finance Leader. The role creates a clear operating-model separation between:

Customer-facing leadership, which owns customer relationships, growth, pipeline development, customer communication, and market execution.
Operations Enablement, which owns internal planning, coordination, operational rigor, standard work, performance visibility, execution follow-through, and issue resolution.

The Regional Operations Leader is accountable for converting strategy and commitments into measurable regional results through disciplined execution, effective people leadership, cross-functional coordination, and timely corrective action.

Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Regional Operations Leader Will

Lead the regional Operations organization.
Operate as a key member of the regional Services leadership team.
Partner with the Regional General Manager and Regional Finance Leader to deliver the region’s Annual Operating Plan.
Lead regional operational rhythms, including sub-regional pulses, operating reviews, MBR preparation, SIOP, capacity planning, cash reviews, campaigns, and initiative execution.
Provide people leadership to designated regional operations roles, which may include:
Contract Renewal Specialists
SPOT Coordinators
Field Service Coordinators
Service Administrators
Cash or collections support roles
Other operational-enablement roles assigned to the region

Serve as the regional escalation and coordination point for operational issues involving Finance, Information Technology, Supply Chain, Digital, Contracts, Business Service Centers, systems, data, and process organizations.

Principal Responsibilities

Regional Operational Leadership and Accountability
Management Operating System and Business Rhythm
Annual Operating Plan and Financial Delivery
Service Contract Execution
SPOT and Reactive Quoted Work
Service Project Operational Excellence
People Leadership and Organizational Capability
Regional Capacity Planning and Labor SIOP
Process Standardization, Systems, and Data
Productivity and Business Improvement
Cross-Functional Partnership
Safety, Quality, and Compliance

Key Performance Indicators
The final targets should be calibrated to the regional baseline, AOP, and approved Honeywell performance framework. The measures below define the recommended KPI structure.
Business and Financial Performance

Regional orders, revenue, operating income, and variable contribution margin versus AOP.
Risk-and-opportunity delivery and forecast accuracy.
Service Contract renewal performance.
SPOT orders, revenue, margin, and backlog conversion.
Service Project revenue conversion, EAC performance, change orders, billing, and job closure.
Cash, past dues, AFDA, disputes, unbilled balances, and working capital.
Productivity commitments and verified financial benefits.

Operational Execution

On-time completion of regional operating actions.
Aged operational actions and escalation closure.
Quote, booking, execution, billing, and closure cycle time.
Renewal and project milestone adherence.
Backlog aging and closure velocity.
First-pass quality of booking, billing, renewal, and project documentation.
Data completeness and timeliness.
Compliance with standard processes, approvals, and GDM requirements.

People and Capability

Employee engagement and retention.
Quality and timeliness of performance and development plans.
Succession coverage for critical roles.
Training and certification completion.
Time to fill critical vacancies.
Capability-gap reduction against regional demand.
Team productivity and workload balance.

Technology and Transformation

Adoption of standard systems and digital workflows.
Reduction in manual reporting and non-value-added work.
Usage and benefit realization from remote delivery, centralized resources, HBOC, GES, and approved digital capabilities.
Process automation benefits.
System and data-quality issue closure.
On-time deployment of regional transformation initiatives

Customer Enablement

Reduction in operational issues requiring customer-facing leader intervention.
Timeliness of response to customer-impacting operational escalations.
Billing and execution issues affecting customer experience.
Successful project-to-service handovers.
Improved operational capacity for customer-facing leaders to focus on relationships, growth, connected offerings, and customer outcomes.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

5+ experience leading people and building accountable, high-performing teams.
5+ years experience using business and financial acumen, including experience with orders, revenue, margin, forecasting, productivity, cash, and working capital.
5+ years experience leading cross-functional operating rhythms and resolving complex execution barriers.
5+years experience using service operations processes, systems, data, tools, and performance metrics.

WE VALUE

Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Finance, Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience across Service Contracts, SPOT, and Service Projects.
Experience with CRM, CPQ, SAP, service-management, project-management, contract-renewal, workforce-planning, analytics, and reporting platforms.
Knowledge of field-service productivity, capacity planning, Labor SIOP, remote delivery, centralized engineering, and subcontractor models.
Experience implementing digital tools, workflow automation, analytics, or AI-enabled operational capabilities.
Experience leading business transformation across multiple branches or geographic areas.
Knowledge of safety, quality, commercial, contract, billing, collections, and compliance requirements in a service environment.
Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
Strong analytical problem-solving and executive communication skills.
Customer-focused judgment combined with disciplined operational execution.

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Learn more
( https://benefits.honeywell.com/ )

About Honeywell Technologies

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. Learn more
( https://www.honeywell.com/us/en )

The annual base salary range for this position is $122,000-$152,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

THE BUSINESS UNIT

Enhance the enjoyment, comfort and energy efficiency of any building, whatever the type or size, with open, scalable, future-ready building automation systems. We work with building integrators to support the installation and integration of building management solutions including building controllers, edge devices and software and connected services.

Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. new_jobs.title: Oracle Project Delivery Manager, Hybrid
new_jobs.description:
Deloitte is the world’s number one professional services firm and making an impact is more than what we do. It is why we are here. We bring challenge, curiosity and edge to every project, driving positive progress for our clients, our people, our communities and the planet. This purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards and to tackle the challenges that matter. Number one never stops challenging.

Joining us means becoming part of a Technology and Transformation team that brings challenge, curiosity and edge to every engagement. Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging.

We offer a competitive starting salary of €75,000.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise. .

Why you’ll enjoy this new opportunity:

At Deloitte, our purpose is to make an impact that matters. Joining our Oracle Enterprise Technology & Performance team, you will play a pivotal role in leading Oracle implementations that drive digital transformation for leading enterprises. This role offers the chance to manage complex, high-value projects across diverse industries, empowering you to develop deep leadership expertise, influence business outcomes, and grow your consulting career within a global, collaborative environment. You'll combine strategic project management with hands-on delivery excellence, shaping how organisations modernise their operations and positioning Deloitte as the trusted advisor for enterprise transformation.

Key skills and prior experience that align well with this position:

Extensive practical experience delivering Oracle projects and workstreams with a proven track record of leading complex projects from planning through execution, combined with a strong understanding of Oracle Cloud ERP modules (Financials, Supply Chain, or HCM) and exposure to solutions architecture.
Proven Project and team leadership capability, with demonstrated experience managing and developing high-performing delivery teams, applying formal project management methodologies (Activate, Waterfall, Agile, PRINCE2), and delivering on time, within scope, and within budget
Exceptional client-facing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong relationships, engage appropriately at all levels (from operational teams to C-suite), and communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences with clarity and impact
Comprehensive delivery expertise spanning project planning and scheduling, risk management, change management, data migration awareness, and testing methodologies, with consulting experience and Oracle certification (Finance or Supply Chain) highly valued

What type of work will I be doing?

Lead and manage large-scale Oracle projects and workstreams, owning planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery to ensure projects meet timelines, budgets, and quality standards
Develop and maintain detailed project plans covering schedules, resource allocation, risk management, and mitigation strategies, with regular updates to senior management and stakeholders
Coordinate cross-functional delivery teams including business stakeholders, technical experts, and external vendors, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment across all workstreams
Monitor progress and manage risk, identifying issues early, implementing mitigation strategies, and conducting regular status meetings to keep all parties informed and engaged
Ensure compliance and best practice adherence throughout the project lifecycle, applying Oracle best practices, industry standards, and company policies to deliver quality outcomes
Lead change management and adoption initiatives, facilitating smooth transitions to new Oracle systems and processes, and supporting stakeholders through organisational change
Build and maintain strong client relationships, managing expectations, communicating effectively, and positioning Deloitte as a trusted strategic advisor throughout the engagement
Contribute to practice growth and pre-sales activities, including RFP responses, solution demonstrations, and identifying opportunities to expand Deloitte’s Oracle delivery capability

Who is the Hiring Manager?

The hiring manager, Trevor Dunne, is an experienced leader within Deloitte’s Oracle Enterprise Technology & Performance team, recognised for a strategic and inclusive leadership style. They champion open communication, professional development, and innovation, fostering a supportive environment that encourages continuous learning and excellence. Their leadership balances high expectations with empathy, ensuring client success and team growth remain paramount.

Where is this role based?

This role is based in Dublin, Ireland, with a flexible hybrid working model combining office and client site presence. For more details on our working approach, please visit our Deloitte Works webpage.

If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process.

What We Offer

Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. We invest in your personal and professional development, empower your work life balance and offer benefits that support you at every stage of life. These include health and wellbeing supports, pension and savings options, training and coaching and enhanced leave options .

new_jobs.title: Implementation Manager
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

Behind many of life’s most important transactions — buying a house, applying for a mortgage, getting a small business loan, or refinancing a credit card — is a network of credit relationships. Setpoint provides critical infrastructure for relationships between the world’s largest banks, credit funds and capital markets counterparties. We’re building trust in this system of credit. Setpoint also uses this infrastructure to provide collateralized debt facilities to businesses. This role will focus mostly on the technology side of the business.

We are looking for an Implementation Manager
to join our team!

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact and partner with multiple functions across the organization. The ideal candidate is highly organized, a clear written and verbal communicator, and proactively identifies and acts on opportunities to improve the way we work. They will collaborate with both internal and external stakeholders. This role reports directly to the Director of Capital Solutions.

Who Will Love This Job

Detail-oriented: You don’t cut corners and quickly grasp complex problems. You are driven to be accurate and maintain a zero-defect approach, even under tight deadlines.
Client-focused: You are passionate about understanding client needs and delivering tailored solutions that create value. You excel at building strong, lasting relationships and ensuring a seamless, positive experience throughout the implementation process.
Team first: you thrive as part of a low-ego team that wins or loses together and jumps in to help each other along the way.
A great communicator: You can clearly explain technical information to a wide range of audiences, from beginner-level users to engineers, when engaging with clients.
An intuitive problem-solver: You are comfortable turning complex ideas into actionable solutions and are enthusiastic about enhancing client experience, our delivery approach, and product effectiveness.
An independent thinker: You can quickly determine what is most important and proactively build solutions to address challenges.

What You’ll Do

Client Management: Lead project management efforts for multiple customer implementations, ensuring clear communication and strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Implementation Oversight: Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to assess project scope, establish delivery milestones, and find and resolve ambiguity before it impacts the project.

About The Job

Every connected-hardware team wants fleet visibility. Getting them there is the job.

nRF Cloud is Nordic Semiconductor's SaaS platform for device observability, fleet analytics, OTA updates, and location services. Our customers ship everything from fitness wearables to home security cameras to medical devices and rely on us to keep those products working in the field.

You’ll own customer onboarding end-to-end and run every engagement like a sprint: scope and success criteria on day one, an accurate timeline, and guiding the customer to first value fast. Our platform deploys quickly. The harder part is people: building alignment where none exists, creating urgency when momentum stalls, and holding the plan together when priorities compete.

We work at startup pace with the scale of a major hardware platform behind us. If this setup sounds like the good part of the job, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding Leadership: Run each customer engagement as a structured, time-boxed project. Set scope and milestones in week one. Own the project plan from kickoff through first value and into production rollout.
Organizational Alignment: Find the gaps between the team that championed the purchase and the engineers doing the integration work, then close them. Build the coalition inside the customer's organization that makes adoption stick and gets them the outcomes they signed up for.
Risk & Blocker Management: Spot the classic onboarding stalls (delayed access, unclear ownership, infrastructure gaps, competing priorities, etc.) while there's still time to fix them, not after the date has slipped. Escalate early and push back when a customer's timeline starts to drift.
Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for all implementation activities. Coordinate the technical team and stay aligned with the Customer Success Manager. Communicate clearly with engineers, support, QA, and executives alike.
Training & Enablement: Lead hands-on workshops that take customers from integrated to self-sufficient: engineers who can triage on their own, dashboards the team actually uses, and runbooks for ongoing operations.
Program Improvement: Help sharpen the onboarding program itself. Spot the patterns behind the engagements that drag and fix the causes, so the next one doesn't.

Qualification And Skills

5+ years of experience in technical program management, implementation, professional services, or a similar customer-facing technical role, with 7+ years of overall professional experience.
Strong project management fundamentals. You run tight sprints, maintain crisp project plans, track milestones with precision, and know which risks surfacing immediately.
Technical aptitude and genuine curiosity about hardware and IoT. You’re fluent in firmware and embedded systems to be credible with engineers and to understand what a completed integration means.

Personal Skills

A natural activator who creates momentum rather than waiting for it.
You’ve experienced first-hand that onboarding failures are organizational, not technical, and you know what to do about it. You’re skilled at surfacing misalignment, creating urgency, and helping teams that weren’t ready to become ready.
Comfortable, challenging customers and escalating when needed.
An excellent communicator who moves fluently between technical and business audiences, from firmware engineers to executives.

Working for Nordic

Working at Nordic, you will be inspired and supported to develop yourself. Our teams enjoy a professional and informal working environment. We value and encourage the continuous development of skills and expertise to the highest levels. We are proud of our Norwegian heritage, our highly skilled international workforce, and our world-leading innovation.

We offer a variety of tasks and projects, and the possibility to work alongside some of the world’s most renowned experts within their field. We encourage our employees to question the established and innovate while expecting professionalism, commitment, and the will to learn.

Founded in 1993, Bayview Asset Management is an investment management firm focused on investments in mortgage and consumer credit, including whole loans, asset-backed securities, mortgage servicing rights, and other credit-related assets.

Bayview is building a dedicated AI Enablement function to accelerate the practical, responsible adoption of AI across the firm. As a Project Manager (AI), you will serve as a senior individual contributor within the function, helping shape how Bayview identifies, prioritizes, delivers, and scales AI-enabled solutions across business units.

This role will own complex, high-impact business engagements from initial discovery through implementation and adoption. You will partner with business leaders to understand strategic priorities and operating challenges, identify where AI can create meaningful value, and determine the right approach—whether through enterprise AI tools, no-code/low-code solutions, process redesign, or partnership with IT for more complex development.

Beyond individual engagements, you will help establish the broader AI Enablement approach across the firm, including prioritization frameworks, reusable solutions, best practices, adoption strategies, and standards for how business teams engage with AI. You will remain hands-on where needed, while providing structure, direction, and expertise across the function.

Responsibilities

Own strategic AI enablement engagements. Lead complex, high-impact engagements with business units, partnering with leaders and subject matter experts to understand priorities, processes, pain points, and opportunities for AI.
Shape the AI opportunity pipeline. Evaluate and prioritize AI opportunities based on business value, feasibility, scalability, risk, and level of effort, helping determine where the function should focus its resources.
Translate strategy into practical solutions. Determine the appropriate solution approach for identified opportunities and drive initiatives from discovery and design through testing, implementation, adoption, and measurement.
Build and scale AI solutions. Develop agents, enterprise skills, prompt workflows, and no-code/low-code automations while identifying opportunities to standardize and reuse successful solutions across the firm.
Establish enablement standards and best practices. Help define frameworks, methodologies, templates, and operating practices that create a consistent and scalable approach to AI enablement across business units.
Partner with IT and technical teams. Identify when opportunities require custom development, integrations, data connectivity, or platform capabilities and translate business needs into clear requirements for technical partners.
Drive enterprise adoption. Develop and lead targeted training, workshops, demonstrations, office hours, and other programs that move teams beyond basic AI usage toward meaningful integration into day-to-day workflows.
Advise business leaders. Serve as a trusted advisor on AI capabilities, use cases, limitations, and emerging opportunities, helping stakeholders distinguish high-value applications from lower-value experimentation.
Measure business impact. Establish success measures for AI initiatives and evaluate adoption, efficiency, productivity, quality, and other business outcomes to inform future investment and prioritization.
Support responsible AI adoption. Partner with appropriate stakeholders to ensure AI solutions align with firm standards for data protection, security, governance, compliance, and cost management.
Evaluate emerging capabilities. Stay current on developments across enterprise AI platforms, models, agents, and automation capabilities; assess their relevance to Bayview and recommend where new capabilities should be piloted or adopted.

Strong hands-on experience with enterprise GenAI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude, including prompt engineering, agents, skills, and AI-enabled workflows
Experience translating ambiguous business problems into structured opportunities, solution approaches, and implementation plans
Ability to evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on business value, feasibility, risk, scalability, and effort
Hands-on ability to build agents, skills, workflows, and automations using no-code/low-code capabilities; deep application development and complex integrations are handled in partnership with IT
Strong executive communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence

Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

MITRE is seeking an experienced Senior Cyber Analyst who will lead high-visibility/high-impact efforts that provide significant contributions to the safety and security of the United States. The position will work closely with sponsor staff and regularly engage with senior leaders to understand their priorities and shape work. Major focus areas include criminal network analysis and disruption, digital marketplaces, and transnational criminal organizations and associated activities. Additional areas of responsibility include cybercrime investigation improvement, cyber-mission systems engineering and guidance, system-of-system engineering, data engineering and analysis, experimentation, communications, and acquisition.

Roles & Responsibilities:

In this role, the selected candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership as a trusted advisor to senior leaders within the sponsor’s organization in the areas of analysis and tradecraft in the fight against crime. Further, the selected candidate will contribute to efforts to:

Conduct Threat Intelligence Analysis: Perform proactive research and analysis of current and emerging cyber threats, with an emphasis on understanding threat actor motivations, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Perform Crypto tracing and Blockchain Analysis: Analyze blockchain transactions to trace cryptocurrency movements associated with malicious activities, collaborating with law enforcement and internal teams to identify potential threat actors.

Collaborate Cross-functionally: Work with other analysts, engineers, and threat intelligence teams to integrate findings, contribute to investigations, and enhance overall security posture.

3-5 years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, crypto tracing, digital forensics, or a related field.

Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and draw meaningful insights. Ability to think critically, recognize patterns, and correlate disparate data points.
Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience in creating analytical reports, summaries, and visual presentations tailored to different audiences.

Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python, R) for data analysis and automation.

Position Description

The best version of us starts with You!

We CGI is looking for passionate and detail-oriented Security Analysts to join our team supporting a leading global Banking client.

The role involves vulnerability remediation and large-scale patch deployment following heightened regulatory focus on AI-enabled cyber threats. The initiative supports cyber hygiene, operational resilience and safe continuity of client’s business services.

Selected candidates will lead the organization’s vulnerability response capability, ensuring vulnerabilities are rapidly identified, assessed, prioritized, remediated, and governed. The role is responsible for reducing cyber risk exposure by coordinating remediation efforts across infrastructure, cloud, application, and technology teams while ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and remediation SLAs.

This is a Full-Time, On-Site employment opportunity located in Jacksonville, FL in a Hybrid Model.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Manage the end-to-end vulnerability response and remediation lifecycle, from identification and assessment through remediation, validation, and closure.

Prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, business criticality, asset exposure, threat intelligence, and potential business impact.

Lead and coordinate vulnerability remediation activities across infrastructure, application, cloud, network, and other technology teams.

Ensure Critical and High-risk vulnerabilities are remediated within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and organizational risk tolerances.

Drive accelerated response and remediation activities for actively exploited vulnerabilities, zero-day vulnerabilities, and emerging security threats.

Collaborate with technology and business stakeholders to track remediation progress, resolve blockers, and manage exceptions or risk acceptances where required.

Monitor vulnerability remediation performance and maintain accurate tracking, status updates, risk assessments, and remediation records.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

At least 9 years of experience as a Security Analyst or in a closely related cybersecurity role:

Significant experience in Vulnerability Management, Cyber Security Operations, or Cyber Defense.
Experience leading remediation programmed across large enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of vulnerability scoring methodologies such as CVSS.
Experience managing technology risk and remediation governance.

Exposure to regulatory environments such as:

NIST SP 800 40
DORA
FCA/PRA requirements
ISO 27001
NIST Cybersecurity Framework

Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.

. This new opportunity will require you to manage risk and closure of contaminated sites in the downstream oil and gas industry. You will design and oversee field work related to monitoring, investigating, and remediating contaminated sites impacted by hydrocarbons (diesel, gasoline crude oil etc.) fertilizers and metals, as well as prepare technical reports. Understanding of the Alberta and Saskatchewan Environmental regulations.
Professional designation is preferred.
Experience in the oil and gas sector will be an asset.

to support the Anti‑Tamper Executive Agent (ATEA) at the Pentagon. Support horizontal protection and cross‑program technology‑security analyses to identify vulnerabilities in accordance with DoDI 5230.28.

Advise on identification, classification, and protection of CPI across RDT&E programs in accordance with DoDI 5200.39 and other governing policies.

We serve as the primary team for evaluating safety metrics and assessing the performance of both human moderation and machine-driven systems, ensuring that our safety standards remain robust and impactful. Working closely with frontline teams, we bring policies to life by providing ongoing guidance and operational support that aligns with our strategic business objectives. Through strong partnerships with Product, Data Science, Policy, Algorithm, ADSO-Search Operations, and front-line teams, we leverage diverse expertise to tackle safety challenges unique to user interactions.

With a commitment to data-driven improvement, we have developed a comprehensive metrics system to evaluate operational effectiveness, including moderation efficiency, quality metrics, and machine performance. By regularly monitoring and enhancing our processes, we work to exceed safety targets, close performance gaps, and continuously elevate the quality of platform interactions.

Our team also leads to building scalable, adaptable safety processes that meet both current and future needs. Through continuous process development, we ensure sustainable efficiencies and maintain operational excellence, evolving with the demands of a safe and thriving community.

About the role
- Operational Safety Management: Develop and implement a comprehensive framework for managing safety associated with Search, Comment and Messaging safety, with a strong focus on critical safety metrics including efficiency and quality metrics (e.g. CGVR, TCOA, and moderation/model performance). This includes setting up standards for key safety projects, workforce planning, enforcement mechanisms, and accuracy to ensure a cohesive and resilient safety strategy.

- Utilize various business platforms and tools proficiently to monitor and analyze project progress effectively, ensuring successful project delivery through proactive identification of potential issues and areas for improvement.
- Lead the analysis of project data to derive valuable insights, enabling data-driven decisions and facilitating strategic initiatives for enhancement. - Bachelor's degree in a related field
- 5+ years of experience in Search or Interaction content moderation operations or quality operations, with a proven track record of designing and implementing quality strategies and initiatives.

- Excellent data analysis and project management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive strategic initiatives from inception to execution.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and requirements.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in process redesign, technology implementation, and automation strategies is highly desirable.

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. new_jobs.title: Geological Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Upstream Data Analyst

Denver, Colorado
Petro-Hunt, L.L.C., a Dallas, Texas mid-sized independent Oil and Gas Exploration Company, is seeking an Upstream Data Analyst for its Denver, Colorado office.

About Petro-Hunt, L.L.C.

Petro-Hunt, L.L.C. is a privately held independent oil and gas company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Owned and operated by the William Herbert Hunt family, Petro-Hunt and its affiliates are actively engaged in various industries with a primary focus in the oil and gas industry.
Our company traces its roots to the 1920s, when the legendary H.L. Hunt entered the oil and gas business in El Dorado, Arkansas, and later played an active role in developing the East Texas Oil Field from the drill test of the Daisy Bradford #3.
Today, Petro-Hunt is a Top 10 Private Liquids Producer in the U.S. with operations in six states. We are more than just an oil and gas company — Petro-Hunt actively purchases minerals and royalties, owns and operates a gas processing facility, is part owner of an oil refinery, actively invests in real estate development, and operates a private equity alternative investment division.

Job Summary

Our Denver office generates and consumes a large amount of data — well logs and subsurface interpretations, daily drilling and completion reports, and production and operations history — and much of it lives in separate systems that do not talk to each other. The Upstream Data Analyst exists to close that gap.
This is a hands-on, analyst-leaning role for someone who is equally comfortable writing a query, wiring two databases together, and presenting a chart that changes a decision. You will pull data from across the drilling, completions, production, and geoscience domains, reconcile it into something trustworthy, and turn it into analysis that geologists, engineers, and management actually use. Just as importantly, you will look for the parts of that work that should not be done by hand twice and automate them — increasingly with the help of AI tooling.
We are looking for curiosity and technical range for this position. If you want to avoid doing repetitive tasks and look forward to digging into the data and databases and creating workflows to answer complex questions, we would like to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities

Data Integration

Connect and reconcile data across disparate upstream systems — drilling and completions reporting (e.g., WellView, Corva), production and operations databases (e.g., P2 Carte), geoscience projects (e.g., Kingdom Suite, GeoGraphix), commercial data vendors (e.g., Enverus, S&P), state regulatory databases, and internal accounting and land systems.
Build and maintain repeatable pipelines that move data between these systems so analysis starts from one trusted source rather than a fresh export.
Migrate and synchronize data between geoscience platforms, corporate databases, and vendor exports, preserving data integrity and auditability along the way.
Resolve the identity problems that make upstream data hard: API number formats, well and completion naming conventions, wellbore vs. producing-entity relationships, and unit and datum inconsistencies.

Analysis and Reporting

Answer real business questions with data — well performance benchmarking, decline behavior as related to geologic variations, and offset operator activity.
Build dashboards, recurring reports, and one-off analyses for geoscience and management audiences.
Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical staff, including the assumptions and data limitations behind them.

Automation and AI

Identify manual, repetitive workflows across the office and replace them with scripted or automated processes.
Apply AI tools — large language models, coding assistants, and data analysis assistants — to accelerate development and deal evaluation, extract information from unstructured sources such as scanned reports and PDFs, and shorten the path from question to answer.
Evaluate new tooling pragmatically and help the office adopt what actually works.

Geoscience Platform and Data Stewardship

Administer geoscience interpretation projects and databases (GeoGraphix strongly preferred; Kingdom Suite or Petra experience considered) — project creation and maintenance, well and log data loading, formation tops, directional surveys, and backup/recovery.
Maintain the health of the geoscience database environment, including direct database-level access for querying, QC, and bulk updates.

Data Quality and Governance

Own the QC of the datasets you build: validate spatial and attribute data, including coordinate reference systems, well headers, directional surveys, and allocation logic.
Document data sources, definitions, and transformations so results are reproducible and auditable.
Help develop and enforce practical data standards and naming conventions across the Denver office.

Cross-Functional Support

Work directly with geologists to support daily workflows and project work.
Serve as the go-to technical resource for geologists’ day-to-day software and data issues.
Serve as a liaison between technical staff and the IT and corporate data groups in Dallas.
Support the preparation of exhibits and data packages for regulatory hearings and internal reviews.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Geology, GIS, Earth Sciences, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

3+ years of relevant technical experience. Candidates with upstream oil and gas experience will be considered at a commensurate level; exceptional early-career candidates who can demonstrate substantial self-directed technical work may also be considered.

Technical Skills

Strong SQL and hands-on experience querying and joining data across relational databases; experience querying vendor application databases directly (e.g., SAP SQL Anywhere/Sybase, SQL Server) is a strong plus.
Proficiency in Python for data work (pandas, or equivalent), including reading and writing common industry formats such as LAS, CSV, and vendor exports.
Experience building visualizations and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Spotfire, Tableau, or Python-based tools).
Comfort with GIS concepts and tools (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS), including coordinate reference systems and spatial joins.
Version control (Git) and general software hygiene are a plus.

AI Proficiency

Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools — large language models, coding assistants, and data analysis assistants — to streamline complex tasks, automate workflows, and enhance productivity. We use these tools daily and expect this person to help us use them better.

Preferred Skills

Working knowledge of upstream oil and gas data: well logs, drilling and completion reporting, production allocation, 2D/3D seismic, and other subsurface data types.
Hands-on administration of a geoscience interpretation platform — GeoGraphix strongly preferred — including its underlying data model and import/export formats.
Experience with commercial data products (Enverus, IHS/S&P, TGS) and state regulatory data sources (NDIC, COGCC/ECMC, RRC).
Exposure to cloud data platforms or modern data stack tooling.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain a result and defend the method behind it.
A bias toward automating the boring parts and a low tolerance for doing the same thing twice.

What We Offer

Fast-paced, well-funded, aggressive work environment in a stable, private company
Direct exposure to decision-makers and real influence over how the office works with data

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Frontier AI Data Labeling
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

Frontier models are only as good as the data they learn from. At Hippocratic AI, that data decides whether an AI agent safely guides a patient through a medication change at 2 a.m.

Our data powers Polaris, a constellation of models with a 700B-parameter core and specialized safety supervisors. In our evaluations, Polaris reaches 99.95% accuracy on drug-safety benchmarks versus 87.9% for the closest voice-deployable frontier model. The labeling, evals, and rater calibration behind it are how we earn and defend numbers like that.

We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to run the human-in-the-loop data labeling engine behind our frontier healthcare AI. That spans audio and conversation annotation, clinician-labeled training data, preference and RLHF data, and the evaluations that decide what ships. You’ll work daily with ML researchers, applied scientists, and licensed clinicians. The data you produce feeds directly into our model training and evaluation loops.

What You’ll Do

Run the data pipelines behind our models. Own end-to-end delivery of labeling and annotation programs, including audio and voice-conversation labeling, supervised labeling, and preference and RLHF data. You’ll manage scoping, task design, execution, QA, and delivery against live model-development cycles.
Turn evals into products. Work with ML and Applied Science to turn evaluation and training-signal needs into concrete labeling tasks, rubrics, and success criteria. Your evals become the benchmarks that gate releases.
Build and scale an expert rater workforce. Source, screen, and onboard clinicians and specialized raters through marketplaces, vendors, and in-house teams. This includes designing qualification tasks, setting rates, and scaling pools up and down as programs change.
Write the guidelines that shape model behavior. Author and iterate labeling guidelines and annotation rubrics, especially for subjective, high-stakes clinical judgment.
Engineer data quality at scale. Design QC systems using gold sets, calibration sessions, spot checks, and inter-rater agreement tracking. Catch rater drift and annotation bottlenecks before they reach training.
Drive velocity and accountability. Track throughput, cost, and quality. Manage vendor relationships (SOWs, performance reviews), choose labeling and QA tooling, and keep Engineering, Clinical, and Infrastructure aligned on dependencies and timelines.

What Success Looks Like

By Day 90: You own a live data labeling or eval program through a major delivery milestone. You’ve cleared a critical bottleneck in the pipeline and shipped one measurable quality or throughput improvement.
By 12 months: You run multiple concurrent labeling and eval programs. Your calibrated rater bench is trusted by ML teams, and you can trace model improvements back to the data you delivered.

What You Bring

5+ years in technical program management or data operations in an AI/ML or data-intensive environment (3+ years considered for exceptional candidates)
2+ years hands-on with data labeling, annotation, or model evaluation, including writing guidelines and managing quality at scale
Experience sourcing and managing contractor or expert annotator workforces through marketplaces (e.g., Mercor, Upwork, Toloka) or labeling vendors
Working knowledge of how annotation quality affects model training, including preference data, pairwise comparisons, and rater calibration (RLHF)
A strong grasp of quality metrics (IAA, precision/recall on gold sets, throughput vs. accuracy tradeoffs)
A track record of owning critical data or eval projects under time pressure, working with ML engineers and applied scientists, and driving results without direct authority
Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, healthcare-adjacent AI environment

Nice to Have

Experience running or supporting RLHF or other training-data pipelines at an AI lab or applied ML team
Clinical, healthcare, or other regulated, high-stakes data experience
Familiarity with Label Studio, Scale AI, Surge AI, or SageMaker Ground Truth
Experience qualifying specialized raters such as clinicians or bilingual SMEs
Exposure to reward hacking and specification gaming, and how annotation design can mitigate them

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.
We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future.
Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.
We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.
Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

new_jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, AI & Data, Global Corporate Communications
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.

A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.

No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
Knowledge of general AI tools
Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions
